in_hebrew.name: Norry
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Norry הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'noreos', meaning 'counselor' or 'advisor'. In the New Testament, Norry could be a diminutive form of the name Hilarion, which means 'shining mountain'. This name carries a deep spiritual significance, reminding us of the importance of seeking wise counsel and guidance in our lives.
